basic_info.description: Elegant, top-floor condominium on one of the best blocks of Noe Valley. Ascending the staircase with charming stained glass window, the gracious main landing is flooded with light from oversized southern windows. Charming Edwardian period details include hardwood flooring, wainscoting, moldings and coved ceilings. An expansive formal living room features 2 south-facing window bays, a marble fireplace flanked by built-in cabinetry, and a separate seating area or home office. At the back of this level is the open, skylit kitchen, equipped with a Wolf range and stainless appliances, quartz countertops, and stylish green cabinetry. A light-filled dining area is tucked into a curved window bay with a skylight overhead and treetop outlooks. Adjacent is a storage closet with in-unit washer and dryer. A door leads out to a fabulous private deck, with stairs down to the beautifully landscaped common garden. The primary bedroom faces the back and is furnished with a window bay and a double closet. A recently updated ensuite bath is outfitted with a shower over tub. Down the hall is a generous 2nd bedroom, and a hallway bath with a shower. Common basement storage, and a private one-car garage for this unit! Steps from 24th Street cafes, shops and dining, 2 parks, Whole Foods, and more.
